title: Accounts & Self-Service UX Research Update and Expansion: 3 Key Takeaways
author: Sally Collins
excerpt: During usability testing at Wayfair, a participant could not find a Start Return action on the order list or details. The return window had closed; removing the button without an explanation caused uncertainty and led her to seek the return policy from the site footer.
scope: Specific observed usability test interaction; not a quantified prevalence across Iranian consumers.
